question: Tell me top10 teams with the most wins across the league
sql:
WITH wins AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team_api_id AS team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM Match
    WHERE away_team_goal > home_team_goal
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name, w.team_api_id, CAST(SUM(w.win_count) AS INTEGER) AS total_wins
FROM wins w
JOIN Team t ON w.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_long_name, w.team_api_id
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10
